charter: Find defects that let an attacker influence the system or that leak private user data.

inputs.summary: Review user_api lookup for sinks and leaks.

issues.title: SQL is interpolated from user_id
issues.whats_wrong: f-string builds SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = '{user_id}'.
issues.why_it_matters: An attacker-controlled user_id can change the query and read other rows.
how_to_fix: Use a parameterized query: WHERE id = %s / ? with user_id bound separately.
acceptance_criteria: The executed SQL text does not contain the raw user_id string.
issues.do_not_change: Returning the settings-page fields that are safe to show.

issues.title: Logs email, session token, and API key
issues.whats_wrong: log.info writes email, session_token, and API_KEY.
issues.why_it_matters: Log sinks become a leak of private user data and a credential store.
acceptance_criteria: A captured log record does not contain email, session_token, or API_KEY.
issues.do_not_change: That a log line still exists for successful load.

issues.title: API_KEY is hardcoded
issues.whats_wrong: A module-level API_KEY string is committed in source.
issues.why_it_matters: Anyone with the repo can call the upstream API as this service.
how_to_fix: Read the key from the environment or the project's secret manager.
acceptance_criteria: No API key literal remains in the module.
issues.do_not_change: The get_user return shape once leaks are removed.

issues.title: Response leaks password_hash and session_token
issues.whats_wrong: The returned dict includes password_hash and session_token.
issues.why_it_matters: The settings page (or any client) receives credentials it does not need.
how_to_fix: Return only id and email (or the fields the page renders).
acceptance_criteria: The response dict has no password_hash or session_token keys.

issues.title: requester_id is unused; no authorization check
issues.whats_wrong: Any requester_id can load any user_id; the argument is never compared.
issues.why_it_matters: This is an IDOR: a logged-in user can read another user's profile.
how_to_fix: Require requester_id == user_id or an admin role before the query.
Return 403 when the requester is not allowed.
acceptance_criteria: A requester asking for a different user_id is denied.
issues.do_not_change: A matching requester_id still loads the row.
